speaker: Ashe
line_text: Long ago, the gods granted their favor to King Raithwall... / who would oversee the subjugation of a vast territory spanning from Ordalia to Valendia. / Here he forged the Galtean Alliance.

speaker: Ashe; no name shown
line_text: Though he is called the Dynast-King... / upon establishing the Alliance, he demonstrated compassion for his people, and disdain for needless war.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: A philosophy passed on to his successors. / One that would bring peace and prosperity for hundreds of years to follow.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: It was during this time of peace that the city-states of Archadia and Rozarria...

speaker: no name shown
line_text: It was during this time of peace that the city-states of Archadia and Rozarria... / each members of Raithwall's Alliance, took root and flourished.

speaker: Ashe; no name shown
line_text: Raithwall left three relics signifying descent from the Dynast-King. / Of these, the Midlight Shard was given to what would become House Nabradia... / and the Dusk Shard to my ancestors, the founders of Dalmasca. / The last of these relics was the Dawn Shard.

speaker: no name shown; Vossler; Ashe
line_text: It remained hidden here, known only to those of royal blood. / As though the Dynast-King foresaw the very plight before us now. / None save descendants of the King are suffered within. If we attempt to enter without proof of such lineage—

speaker: Balthier
line_text: There's no guarantee we'll make it out alive. / Vicious beasts. Fiendish traps. / Something like that?

speaker: Ashe; Balthier
line_text: But you must consider the prize. / The Dawn Shard lies within. And Raithwall's treasure. / And there was I thinking this was going to be hard!

trigger: requested by ＡＤ.バトルヒント
line_text: Fight or run, we better decide fast!

trigger: requested by ディレクター.イベント進行
speaker: Vaan
line_text: Vaan What was that thing?

trigger: requested by ディレクター.イベント進行
speaker: no name shown
line_text: Balthier A contraption you'd find in all but the most rudimentary ancient ruin. One touch, and off you're whisked to you know not where.

trigger: requested by ディレクター.イベント進行
speaker: Balthier
line_text: Balthier The finer points of their operation elude me, but they're handy all the same. What more need a sky pirate know?

trigger: requested by ＡＤ.バトルヒント
line_text: The wall comes. We must be quick! Together we can bring it down!

speaker: Vossler
line_text: Incredible...

speaker: Vossler
line_text: It wounds me to look on as they pillage so solemn a place.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Yet without help, you and I are as nothing. / Is this not so?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: He thinks ever and always on his own profit. / Assure him of it, and he shall remain true to our cause.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: I do not share Your Majesty's trust.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: We will continue this later. / Now we should concern ourselves with finding the Dawn Shard.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: It sleeps, in waiting. Somewhere deep within.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: How can you be certain?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I can hear its call.

speaker: Fran; Ashe
line_text: In vainglory they arose, shouting challenges at the gods. / But prevail they did not. Their doom it was to walk the Mist until Time's end. / A legend of the nu mou. / My family tells a story of the Dynast-King and an Esper. / The story goes that in his youth, the Dynast-King defeated a mighty gigas... / for which the gods took heed of him. Thereafter, it was ever bound to him in thralldom.

speaker: Balthier; Ashe
line_text: So all this time it's been here guarding the Dynast-King's treasure. / Not so. The Esper is the Dynast-King's treasure. / That's your treasure?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: In this Esper we now command rests a power whose worth is beyond any measure.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Is that so? / Call me old-fashioned, but I was hoping for a treasure whose worth we could measure.
